Class ClientController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.controller.ClientController
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerConnectionUser, MessageReceiver
public class ClientController extends Object implements ServerConnectionUser, MessageReceiver
Main controller class on the client side. Coordinates network communications, delegates incoming messages to an asynchronous executor, and translates UI interactions into commands for the server.

      public ClientController(UI ui, ClientModel localModel)

      Parameters:

      localModel - the client's local representation of the game state
